title: OpenSpec schema registry
description: The registry of OpenSpec workflow schemas published for other projects to install.

$schema.description: Points at this schema so an editor can validate the file while it is edited.

schemas.description: The registry entries, sorted ascending by id.

id.description: Registry-unique slug of the form <owner>/<name>, lowercase and permanent.

name.description: The schema's own declared name, with upstream's casing. Not unique across the registry.

description.description: One line written for the registry, at most 100 characters.

artifacts.description: The artifact ids the schema declares, in order, copied from its schema.yaml.

path.description: Directory inside the repository holding schema.yaml.

ref.description: Tag, branch or commit. Absent means the repository's default branch.

openspec.description: Minimum OpenSpec version. Advisory; the registry does not verify it.

superseded_by.description: The id of the entry replacing this one. Only on a deprecated entry.

license.description: SPDX identifier. Absent means the licence is unknown, not that there is none.

language.description: Language of the schema's instructions and templates. Absent means en.
